rules.name: SSOT Rule
rules.description: データのパース・カナ生成の重複・二重実装を禁止するルール

forbidden_patterns.message: townKanaMapの再生成（二重生成）は禁止されています。v2_extract.gsのメタデータのみを参照してください。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Do not duplicate townKana mapping structures. Instead, consume the unified metadata returned by v2_extract.gs.
nextAction: Refactor code to reference v2_extract.gs attributes

forbidden_patterns.message: CSVファイルの直接パースはv2_extract.gsにのみ閉じている必要があります。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Do not call Utilities.parseCsv directly. SSOT parsing is delegated exclusively to v2_extract.gs.

rules.name: One Responsibility Rule
rules.description: GAS（サーバー）側コードにブラウザ依存のオブジェクト（window/documentなど）が混入するのを防止するルール

forbidden_patterns.message: GAS（サーバー）側で window オブジェクトを参照することはできません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove browser environment global 'window' references from server-side scripts.
nextAction: Use server-safe parameters or options properties

forbidden_patterns.message: GAS（サーバー）側で document オブジェクトを参照することはできません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove browser DOM global 'document' references from server-side scripts.
nextAction: Inject or pass DOM dependencies strictly on the client-side

forbidden_patterns.message: GAS（サーバー）側で navigator オブジェクトを参照することはできません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove navigator global reference from server-side scripts.

forbidden_patterns.message: GAS（サーバー）側で localStorage オブジェクトを参照することはできません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove localStorage references from server-side scripts. Use CacheService or PropertiesService on GAS instead.
nextAction: Replace storage method with CacheService or PropertiesService

rules.name: Foundation First Rule
rules.description: データ定義やモデル設計を優先する原則

rules.name: No Duplicate Logic Rule
rules.description: 同一のユーティリティが重複定義されていないかチェックするルール

rules.name: Layer Separation Rule
rules.description: OSの階層構造（API, UI, Audit）における逆方向の呼び出しを禁止するルール

forbidden_patterns.message: イベントカーネル（v2_kernel.gs）からHtmlService（UIレンダリング）を呼び出すことはできません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Kernel must remain headless. Do not call HtmlService inside v2_kernel.gs.
nextAction: Move HTML rendering logic to UI layer

rules.name: Naming Rule
rules.description: アプリやブランチ、変数名などの命名規則の検証

rules.name: Version Rule
rules.description: APIレスポンス等に version が含まれているか検証するルール

forbidden_patterns.message: areaSummary APIレスポンスオブジェクトに version プロパティが含まれていません。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Include 'version' parameter in AreaSummary JSON responses.
nextAction: Add 'version: 1' key-value pair to AreaSummary push structure

rules.name: Backward Compatibility Rule
rules.description: 既存のAPIアクションが破壊的に変更・削除されていないか確認するルール

required_patterns.message: 既存 of APIアクション 'getAppData' が破壊的に削除または変更されています。
required_patterns.remediation: Preserve support for 'getAppData' API action route.
nextAction: Restore case 'getAppData' routing block inside doGet

required_patterns.message: 既存 of APIアクション 'getRanking' が破壊的に削除または変更されています。
required_patterns.remediation: Preserve support for 'getRanking' API action route.
nextAction: Restore case 'getRanking' routing block inside doGet

required_patterns.message: 既存 of APIアクション 'getRoster' が破壊的に削除または変更されています。
required_patterns.remediation: Preserve support for 'getRoster' API action route.
nextAction: Restore case 'getRoster' routing block inside doGet

rules.name: Read Only Rule
rules.description: クライアント側で AreaSummary 等の読み取り専用メタデータの直接書き換えを禁止するルール

forbidden_patterns.message: クライアント側で AreaSummary (done/total) を直接更新することは禁止されています。
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Treat AreaSummary metadata as read-only. Mutate states exclusively on the backend via transaction event logs.
nextAction: Remove direct assignment to summary elements
Refactor code to trigger backend update actions

rules.name: Governance Rule
rules.description: ロックアカウントやシステムロックIDのバイパス・改ざんの禁止

required_patterns.message: SYSTEM_LOCKのアカウント設定が改ざんされています。
SYSTEM_LOCKのACTIVE_DRIVE_ROOT_ID設定が改ざんされています。

rules.name: Human Approval Rule
rules.description: Implementation SHALL NOT start before explicit human approval. Check that targets are authorized before coding.

forbidden_patterns.message: Task requires explicit human approval before implementing any source changes.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Obtain human approval gate clearance by running the project manager approve command.
nextAction: Mark approval flag to true inside ai_tasks.json

rules.name: Implementation Plan Hash Rule
rules.description: Implementation plan MUST NOT be modified after approval without re-approval. Check plan hash alignment.

forbidden_patterns.message: Approved Implementation plan has been modified after receiving human approval.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Request explicit re-approval by running the project manager approve command again to sync plan hash.
nextAction: Submit the plan modification for review

rules.name: Execution Gate Rule
rules.description: No implementation code, walkthrough, release notes, or git operations allowed unless executionState is RUNNING.

forbidden_patterns.message: Execution is locked. No changes are authorized before starting an active execution session.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Start an active execution session by running: python3 tools/ai_project_manager.py --start-execution <taskId>

rules.name: Execution Token Validation Rule
rules.description: Implementation requires a valid, non-expired Execution Token. Block work if token is missing or expired.

forbidden_patterns.message: Missing, mismatched, or expired Execution Token.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Request plan approval and token issuance by running the approve command.

rules.name: Single Active Execution Rule
rules.description: Only one active execution session is allowed per task to prevent concurrency conflicts.

forbidden_patterns.message: Concurrency collision: another execution session is already active.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Wait for the active session to finish, or terminate it before starting a new one.

rules.name: Kernel Isolation Rule
rules.description: AI SHALL NOT write to source files directly. Any modification must go through the protected AIOS Kernel interface via Transformation Proposals.

forbidden_patterns.message: Direct write violation: AI attempted to modify source code directly without Kernel mediation.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Submit changes as a Transformation Proposal (Unified Diff) through the validation kernel.

rules.name: Sandbox Enforcement Rule
rules.description: Any direct file write detected without Kernel validation blocks build and commits.

forbidden_patterns.message: Sandbox lock active: direct filesystem manipulation is forbidden.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Verify and obtain a signed proposal validation certificate from the kernel.
